profile.name: Modbus TCP从站设备
profile.description: 支持 Modbus TCP 协议的工业现场设备，如 PLC、远程 I/O 模块、仪表或控制器。实验室中常通过以太网读取线圈、离散输入和寄存器数据，并写入控制位或设定值，用于设备监测、数据采集、联机调试和自动化控制实验。
profile.description_en: An industrial field device that supports the Modbus TCP protocol, such as a PLC, remote I/O module, meter, or controller. In laboratory use, it is commonly accessed over Ethernet to read coils, discrete inputs, and registers, and to write control bits or setpoints for equipment monitoring, data acquisition, integration testing, and automation experiments.
